style: Use case: illustration-story. Original high-resolution editorial illustration for a professional English Ladder learner-book cover. Landscape 1536x1024. Polished hand-drawn educational publishing style: crisp fine dark outlines, softly modeled forms, natural adult proportions, realistic hands. Diverse adults of equal professional standing. Cobalt and clear medium blue, restrained coral and gold, neutral white and charcoal. Pure white background, a self-contained workplace vignette with generous white margins, no decorative frame. Entire relevant people and objects visible. No text, letters, brand names, logos, watermark, or sea-green background. Do not depict hazardous work being performed. The image should communicate the occupation through the specific work being discussed, not through generic suits and charts. IMPORTANT: Show only abstract shapes and lines on screens, documents and packaging; absolutely no readable writing, letters, numbers, logos, slogans or health claims. All arms and hands must be anatomically connected and physically plausible, never passing through a screen, table or other solid object.

production_notes: 65 replacement covers; 14 recent medical/specialist illustrations and the Leadership cover are reused.

The no-readable-writing/anatomy constraint was strengthened during production; targeted corrections removed marketing wording, an extraneous pharmacy child, an extra plumbing hand, and a laboratory glove touching a face. Kitchen caps were added to the cooks cover.
Diverse cast variations were used across batches; figures are fictional, not photographs of identifiable people.
All final cover PNGs were visually reviewed. Native generator only; no paid API or external repository.
